evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex medial meniscal tear with extrusion and displaced flap fragment.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Small tears at the anterior and posterior root attachments of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning and irregularity, most prominent at the posterior weightbearing aspect with a small chondral flap at the medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring at the medial patellar facet.
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
